purpose: Track latency, usage units, provider metadata, external calls and attributable operational cost across Nexus capabilities.
rules: Every external or metered capability should carry a correlation_id.
Usage entries contain operational metadata, not business payloads or source records.
Costs are explicit numeric amounts with currency and must never be inferred silently.
Unavailable pricing produces zero/unknown cost metadata rather than fabricated estimates.
Observability failure must never break the business capability being observed.
